title: Próxima mejora: textos y tonalidades por voicing
summary: Encargo de rótulos enmarcados, grado y tonalidad por voicing con herencia de color y visibilidad global; implementado en 0.5.0.
notes: Manifest declared SPEC; applied as authoritative. Content also contains requirement-style sections (Cambios pedidos, Criterios de entrega) that resemble PRD signals, and it records itself as a feature request with implementation decisions. Those signals are retained for the synthesizer. Output filename uses a non-hashed fallback because no hashing tool was available to this classifier; source_hash could not be computed.
